description: Exploit: test the untested −0.5 point of the epoch dial. Apply it to the current tip: E017, or I033's recipe if I033 is kept. Cut 0.5 true epoch uniformly, for example about 9.5 → 9.0 true epochs; read the exact step count from the code first (H4.2.3). Resolution phases stay fixed fractions of total steps (40/30/30, so the 32 px tail keeps its 30% share). The LR and Lookahead/EMA schedules stretch to the new step count, as in E008/E020. Compiled shapes are unchanged and error_on_recompile stays on. Changing the step count also changes RNG consumption, so seeds 0–2 get re-rolled. So in the same session, run the recipe offline on held-out seeds 3–12 (benchmark.run --seed 3 --n 10). Base keep or discard on both numbers, not on the 3-seed mean alone. Do not re-roll RNG streams to chase a lucky seeds-0–2 draw.
